@deskIpRequestTitle.description: Title of the screen that makes an in-person payment request (a code the payer's phone scans).

@deskIpPayTitle.description: Title of the screen that makes an in-person send code (the other phone scans it to receive).

@deskIpReceiveTitle.description: Title of the review of a scanned or pasted in-person send code.

@deskIpPayRequestTitle.description: Title of the review of a scanned or pasted in-person request code.

@deskIpMakeCode.description: Button: make the in-person code and show it.

deskIpCodeLeadRequest: The payer scans this code or pastes its text.

@deskIpCodeLeadRequest.description: Line under an in-person request code.

deskIpCodeLeadPay: The other phone scans this code or pastes its text.

@deskIpCodeLeadPay.description: Line under an in-person send code.

@deskIpCodeText.description: Label of the in-person code's text, which can be copied.

@deskIpCodeOf.description: What the QR code shows, lower case; used inside 'Show QR code of the {title}'.

deskIpExpiresIn: {count, plural, one{Expires in about {count} min.} other{Expires in about {count} min.}}

@deskIpExpiresIn.description: How long the in-person code works; count is minutes.

@deskIpWaiting.description: Status while an in-person code waits for the other phone's answer.

@deskIpCheckPayer.description: Check question after the payer answered a request code; code is four digits.

@deskIpCheckOther.description: Check question after the other phone answered a send code; code is four digits.

@deskIpMatches.description: Button: the other phone shows the same check code.

@deskIpDifferent.description: Button: the other phone shows another check code; the payment stops.

@deskIpSent.description: Done screen of an in-person payment this wallet sent.

@deskIpReceived.description: Done screen of an in-person request that was paid.

@deskIpPasteAnswer.description: Button: paste the other phone's answer from the clipboard.

@deskIpScanAnswer.description: Button: scan the other phone's answer with the camera.

@deskIpAnswerLabel.description: Label of the field where the other phone's answer text is pasted.

deskIpNotAnswer: Not an answer to this code.

@deskIpNotAnswer.description: Inline error: the pasted or scanned text is not an answer to the code on screen.

@deskIpReceiveButton.description: Button: receive the in-person payment shown.

@deskIpPayButton.description: Button: pay the in-person request shown.

@deskIpCheckTitle.description: Title over the four-digit check code this phone shows after answering.

deskIpCheckLead: The other phone must show the same code.

@deskIpCheckLead.description: Line under the check code: the other side compares it before it finishes.

deskIpAnswerLead: The other phone scans this answer or pastes its text.

@deskIpAnswerLead.description: Line over the answer shown as a QR code when it cannot go through a server.

@deskIpAnswerOf.description: What the QR code shows, lower case; used inside 'Show QR code of the {title}'.

@deskIpUseServerAsk.description: Title: the code names a message server that is not in the wallet's server list.

deskIpNotInList: {host} is not in your server list.

@deskIpNotInList.description: Text under 'Send through this server?'; host is a server address.

@deskIpUseServer.description: Button: send through the server named by the code.

@deskIpScanTitle.description: Title of the camera screen that reads an in-person code or answer.

deskIpScanAim: Point the camera at the other phone's code.

@deskIpScanAim.description: Line on the camera screen before anything is read.

@deskIpCopied.description: Notice after the code or answer text was copied.

deskIpPostFailed: The answer did not go through. Try again.

@deskIpPostFailed.description: The answer could not be posted to the server; the user can retry.

@deskIpOnlineLine.description: Quiet status line under an in-person code while its answer comes back through an Epicbox server; host is the server's name. Tapping it opens the details.

@deskIpOnlineSending.description: Status line in place of the answer QR code while the answer goes to the code's Epicbox server.

deskIpOnlineDown: Epicbox server not reachable · trying again

@deskIpOnlineDown.description: Status line under an in-person code when the Epicbox server did not answer; the wallet keeps asking.

@deskIpOnlineTitle.description: Title of the details of an in-person answer going through an Epicbox server.

@deskIpOnlineServer.description: Label of the row naming the Epicbox server the answer goes through.

@deskIpOnlineStatus.description: Label of the row with the online answer's current step.

@deskIpOnlineTimeLeft.description: Label of the row with how long the in-person code still works.

@deskIpOnlineMinutes.description: Value of the Time left row; count is minutes.

@deskIpStepPosting.description: Online answer step: this wallet sends its answer to the Epicbox server.

@deskIpStepSent.description: Online answer step: the answer reached the Epicbox server.

@deskIpStepReceived.description: Online answer step: the other phone's answer came in.

@deskIpStepDown.description: Online answer step: the Epicbox server did not answer; the wallet keeps asking.

@deskIpStepFailed.description: Online answer step: the answer could not be sent to the Epicbox server.

@deskIpStepCancelled.description: Online answer step: the user cancelled the online reply.

@deskIpOnlineCancel.description: Button: stop sending or waiting online; the answer then goes by scan or paste.

deskIpOnlineCancelCode: Then scan or paste the other phone's answer.

@deskIpOnlineCancelCode.description: Line under Cancel online reply on the side that shows the code.

deskIpOnlineCancelAnswer: Then the other phone scans your answer.

@deskIpOnlineCancelAnswer.description: Line under Cancel online reply on the side that answered the code.

@deskIpOnlineDetails.description: Screen reader hint of the online answer status line: tapping it opens its details.
